verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such resource: probes for llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs on support.microsoft.com all returned HTTP 404, and no first-party doc mentions agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
